populate_magic_school_with_procedural_spell_list_effect = {
	while = {
		count = $COUNT$
		random_list = {
			3 = { save_scope_value_as = { name = procedural_spell_level value = 1 } }
			10 = { save_scope_value_as = { name = procedural_spell_level value = 2 } }
			8 = { save_scope_value_as = { name = procedural_spell_level value = 3 } }
			5 = { save_scope_value_as = { name = procedural_spell_level value = 4 } }
			3 = { save_scope_value_as = { name = procedural_spell_level value = 5 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:procedural_spell_level }
			generate_procedural_spell_effect = { LEVEL = scope:procedural_spell_level QUALITY = 0 }
			
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:new_spell_scope }
				assign_spell_to_magic_school_effect = { SPELL = scope:new_spell_scope }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Generate randomized baseline aspects of a spell
# Needs to be executed in magic school scope
## Parameters:
### LEVEL - Spell level
## Scope Parameters:
### magic_school_scope - If not, will be totally random
generate_spell_aspects_effect = {
	# Determine how many aspects the spell will have
	random_list = {
		4 = {
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = random_spell_aspect_number_value
				value = 1
			}
		}
		8 = {
			trigger = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable_list = aspect_list }
					variable_list_size = { name = aspect_list value > 1 }
				}
				$LEVEL$ > 1
			}
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = random_spell_aspect_number_value
				value = 2
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = non_school_aspect_allowed
					value = yes
				}
			}
		}
		1 = {	# 3-Aspect spells very rare
			trigger = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable_list = aspect_list }
					variable_list_size = { name = aspect_list value > 2 }
				}
				$LEVEL$ > 2
			}
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = random_spell_aspect_number_value
				value = 3
			}
			random = {
				chance = 30
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = non_school_aspect_allowed
					value = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Save remaining aspect points
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = remaining_spell_level_points

		while = {
			count = scope:random_spell_aspect_number_value
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						NOT = { exists = var:fire }

							exists = var:magic_school.var:fire
							exists = scope:non_school_aspect_allowed
						}
					}
					modifier = {
						factor = {
							value = var:magic_school.var:fire
							multiply = 2
						}
						exists = var:magic_school.var:fire
					}

						limit = { NOT = { exists = var:magic_school.var:fire } }

					}
				}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:fire }
		if = {	# Always cap an aspect if no spell effects use it for scaling
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_in_list = {
						variable = spell_effect_list
						OR = {
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:fire
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:total_spell_level
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = fire_max
				value = var:fire
			}
		}
		else = {
			random = {
				chance = 50

							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:metal
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:total_spell_level
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = metal_max
				value = var:metal
			}
		}
		else = {
			random = {
				chance = 50
				set_variable = {
					name = metal_max
					value = {
						value = var:metal
						add = { integer_range = { min = 0 max = 5 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:time }
		if = {	# Always cap an aspect if no spell effects use it for scaling
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_in_list = {
						variable = spell_effect_list
						OR = {
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:time
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:total_spell_level
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = time_max
				value = var:time
			}
		}
		else = {
			random = {
				chance = 50
				set_variable = {
					name = time_max
					value = {
						value = var:time
						add = { integer_range = { min = 0 max = 5 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:dawn }
		if = {	# Always cap an aspect if no spell effects use it for scaling
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_in_list = {
						variable = spell_effect_list
						OR = {
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:dawn
							var:scalar_1 ?= flag:total_spell_level
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = dawn_max
				value = var:dawn
			}
		}
		else = {
			random = {
				chance = 50
				set_variable = {
					name = dawn_max
					value = {
						value = var:dawn
						add = { integer_range = { min = 0 max = 5 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						}
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = spell_effect_chance_scope
					value = {
						integer_range = {
							min = 5
							max = 25

				add_variable_to_last_created_spell_effect_tag = { VARIABLE_TYPE = spell_effect_chance_iteration VALUE = scope:spell_effect_chance_iteration_scope }
				# Reward the randomness by lowering the scalar threshold

			}
			add_procedural_spell_effect_tag_to_last_created_spell_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_trait_infirm TARGET = $TARGET$ }
			# Does the effect have a random chance of firing?
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = {
						value = 0

						if = {

							add = 10
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:hymns }
							add = 5
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:death }
							add = 5
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:sand }
							add = 5
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:metal }
							add = 5
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:time }
							add = 5
						}
						if = {
							limit = { exists = var:dawn }
							add = 5
						}
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = spell_effect_chance_scope
					value = {
						integer_range = {
							min = 5
							max = 25
						}
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = spell_effect_chance_iteration_scope
					value = {
						integer_range = {
							min = 5
							max = 25
						}
					}
				}
				add_variable_to_last_created_spell_effect_tag = { VARIABLE_TYPE = spell_effect_chance VALUE = scope:spell_effect_chance_scope }
				add_variable_to_last_created_spell_effect_tag = { VARIABLE_TYPE = spell_effect_chance_iteration VALUE = scope:spell_effect_chance_iteration_scope }
				# Reward the randomness by lowering the scalar threshold
				random_list = {
					1 = { }	# Nope
					2 = {
						scope:new_tag ?= {
							change_variable = {
								name = scalar_threshold
								subtract = 1
							}
						}
					}
					1 = {
						scope:new_tag ?= {
							change_variable = {
								name = scalar_threshold
								subtract = 2
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

# Automatically generate cantrip-type effects
generate_cantrip_effects_effect = {
	add_sub_spell_with_offset_to_last_created_spell_effect = { SPELL_IDENTIFIER = cantrip_subspell OFFSET = $ASPECT_OFFSET$ }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = affects_target_effect_list
		save_temporary_scope_as = spell_effect_being_copied
		if = {
			limit = { var:spell_tag_name ?= flag:add_character_modifier_magic_health_gain_modifier }
			prev = {
				if = {
					limit = { 
						AND = {
							exists = scope:spell_effect_being_copied
							exists = scope:spell_effect_being_copied.var:scalar_threshold
						}
					}
					save_scope_value_as = {
						name = cantrip_threshold
						value = {
							value = scope:spell_effect_being_copied.var:scalar_threshold
							add = $THRESHOLD_OFFSET$
						}
					}
				}
				
				add_spell_effect_tag_to_last_created_spell_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_character_modifier_magic_health_gain_modifier_permanent TARGET = cantrip_wielder SCALED_BY = scope:spell_effect_being_copied.var:scalar_1 THRESHOLD = scope:cantrip_threshold }
				scope:new_tag ?= { save_temporary_scope_as = copied_spell_effect_scope }	# So that "new_tag" scopes created outside the context of this function don't accidentally get used
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:spell_tag_name ?= flag:add_artifact_modifier_magic_health_gain_modifier }

generate_cantrip_effects_for_last_created_spell_effect = {
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= {
		generate_cantrip_effects_effect = { ASPECT_OFFSET = $ASPECT_OFFSET$ THRESHOLD_OFFSET = $THRESHOLD_OFFSET$ }
	}
}

# Automatically generate artifact-type effects
generate_enchantment_effects_effect = {
	add_sub_spell_with_offset_to_last_created_spell_effect = { SPELL_IDENTIFIER = enchantment_subspell OFFSET = $ASPECT_OFFSET$ }
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= {
		create_spell_trigger_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = spell_trigger_not_has_enchantment_of_ritual TARGET = target_artifact GROUP = casting }
		create_spell_trigger_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = spell_trigger_under_enchantment_limit TARGET = target_artifact GROUP = casting }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:enchantment_style ?= flag:gemstone
				NOT = { exists = var:stone }
			}
			set_variable = { name = artifact_stone value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:enchantment_style ?= flag:inscription
				NOT = { exists = var:celestial }
			}
			set_variable = { name = artifact_celestial value = 2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:fire }
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = fire_increase
			value = {
				value = var:fire
				add = {
					value = $ASPECT_OFFSET$
					multiply = fire_aspect_spell_ratio_value
					floor = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:fire_increase }
			set_variable = {
				name = artifact_fire
				value = scope:fire_increase
			}
			scope:new_spell_scope ?= { create_spell_effect_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_artifact_aspect_fire TARGET = target_artifact SCALED_BY = flag:fire THRESHOLD = "{ value = scope:fire_increase subtract = 1 }" }	}

				}
				clear_saved_scope = copied_spell_effect_scope
			}
		}
	}
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= { create_spell_effect_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_ritual_to_enchantment_list TARGET = target_artifact SCALED_BY = flag:total_spell_level THRESHOLD = 0 } }
	set_spell_target_type_gold_cost_of_last_created_spell_effect = { TARGET = target_artifact VALUE = very_high_spell_gold_cost }
}

generate_enchantment_effects_for_last_created_spell_effect = {
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= { generate_enchantment_effects_effect = { ASPECT_OFFSET = $ASPECT_OFFSET$ THRESHOLD_OFFSET = $THRESHOLD_OFFSET$ } }
}

generate_crafting_effects_for_last_created_spell_effect = {
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= {
		add_variable_to_last_created_spell = { VARIABLE_TYPE = artifact_metal VALUE = 2 }
		create_spell_effect_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = create_artifact_necklace TARGET = spell_organizer SCALED_BY = flag:metal THRESHOLD = -1 }
		add_variable_to_last_created_spell_effect_tag = { VARIABLE_TYPE = casting_mode VALUE = flag:artifact }
		create_spell_effect_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = make_artifact_primary_target TARGET = newly_created_artifact SCALED_BY = flag:metal THRESHOLD = -1 }
		generate_enchantment_effects_effect = { ASPECT_OFFSET = $OFFSET$ THRESHOLD_OFFSET = $OFFSET$ }
	}
}

#########################################################################################
# Author: Taelwynn																		#
# Desc: Generates a tattoo subspell and assigns the tattoo triggers, as well as			#
#		adding gh_ritual_tattoo trait_xp and adding ritual to the global tattoo_list.	#
# Convention: Offsets are for how the base aspects are scaled, not the effects. Tattoos #
#		should generally be offset by about 1-3, depending on how well the spell scales #
#########################################################################################
generate_tattoo_subspell_effect = { # Creates tattoo subspell and applies tatto spell casting triggers
	add_sub_spell_with_offset_to_last_created_spell_effect = { SPELL_IDENTIFIER = tattoo_subspell OFFSET = $OFFSET$ }
	add_tattoo_triggers_and_effects_to_last_created_spell = { SCALED_BY = $SCALED_BY$ THRESHOLD = $THRESHOLD$ }
}

add_tattoo_triggers_and_effects_to_last_created_spell = { # Creates tattoo subspell and applies tatto spell casting triggers
	scope:new_spell_scope ?= {
		create_spell_trigger_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = spell_trigger_not_has_tattoo_of_ritual TARGET = target GROUP = casting}
		create_spell_trigger_tag_scripted_effect = { NAME = spell_trigger_not_has_maxed_out_gh_ritual_tattoos_track TARGET = target GROUP = casting}
	}
	add_spell_effect_tag_to_last_created_spell_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_trait_xp_gh_ritual_tattoos TARGET = target SCALED_BY = $SCALED_BY$ THRESHOLD = $THRESHOLD$ }
	add_spell_effect_tag_to_last_created_spell_scripted_effect = { NAME = add_ritual_to_tattoo_list TARGET = target SCALED_BY = $SCALED_BY$ THRESHOLD = $THRESHOLD$ }	
}
